title: Golem: sealed body, killable head that flies free, punching fists
player_outcome: Golem's body is sealed while its head lives. The head spits fireballs and eye lasers, and when destroyed it flies free, still firing, until the body falls. Its stone fists punch out at you and can be broken. It enrages if you leave the temple.
design: golem (model golem_body): pattern ground with walk and hop. Landings use slam or hop plus an AfterMove impact.
Phase shieldedBy 'golem_head'. Parts: golem_head [0, 2.6, 0.2] with Bar true; golem_fist [−2.0, 0.6, 0.4] mirror true; golem_fist [2.0, 0.6, 0.4].
Enrage {when [{type biome, none [temple]}], damage 1.5, speed 1.5} if a temple zone biome exists; else skip.

golem_head: anchored pattern brain with fireball and eye-laser volleys; boss block with the same flag so it shows on the bar. onDeath spawnEnemies golem_head_free, with a new SpawnEnemiesParams.Tether: the child is tethered to the dying npc's Leader and dies with the body.
golem_head_free: flyer brain with the golem_laser ranged attack; invulnerable.
golem_fist: skeletronHand brain, new style 'punch' (launch straight at the target at 20 m/s, hold 10 ticks, retract).
Terraria values (tune): body 39000/26 defense/72 damage; head 16000/20 defense; fists 6000/26 defense/59 damage.
